name: Notice of Intent to Retain or Replace Superintendent/Assistant Superintendent
description: Board action at a public meeting notifying the Superintendent or Assistant Superintendent whether the Board intends to retain them for a further term or consider other candidates; failure to act extends the term one year.
deadline: At a public Board meeting at least 90 days prior to expiration of the term of office
quote: At a public Board meeting occurring at least ninety (90) days prior to the expiration date of the Superintendent’s or an Assistant Superintendent’s term of office, the Board meeting agenda shall include an item requiring affirmative action by five (5) or more Board members to notify the Superintendent or Assistant Superintendent that the Board intends to retain them
